sources.fact: LBBD37/DO Ground to 2nd Floor Units 2,3,4 & 5 Town Quay Wharf is 0.06ha with 15 minimum/maximum net dwellings.
The current DO37 record carries planning-permission-status permissioned and Notes: Lapsed; the lapse is preserved.
The DO37 record gives full planning permission date 30 June 2017 and a distinct planning-history id 21874.
DO37 supplies a point and blank geometry, neither of which is an HMLR title or exact planning red-line.
LBBD20/DO 6-8 Town Quay is a separate 9-home lapsed Brownfield record with planning-history id 21870; DO20 and DO37 are not automatically aggregated.
LBBD83/HQ Town Quay Wharf is a separate current 147-home Brownfield record with full permission dated 15 February 2022.
Be First describes the HQ Town Quay Wharf scheme as 147 apartments comprising 62 council homes and 85 private-sale apartments plus commercial space.
Be First's 2023 update identifies 62 affordable units within the 147-home HQ scheme, including 29 London Affordable Rent and 33 shared ownership.
December 2024 Cabinet minutes describe disposal of homes at Town Quay Wharf and Transport House by long leases following practical completion over the coming months.

The related decision expected Town Quay Wharf and Transport House schemes to be completed in January 2025 and identifies Town Quay Wharf flats 1-62 Mercia Peak; this is HQ delivery/governance evidence, not DO37 evidence.
LBBD states all Brownfield Register sites require planning permission.
Local Plan policy/allocation context does not merge separate planning entities or revive a lapsed DO37 consent.

examples.result: DO37 remains a 15-home lapsed-record candidate; its old permission is not treated as extant.
DO37 planning-history id 21874 remains separate from DO20 id 21870.
DO37 15 and DO20 9 are not summed without exact allocation/subsite topology and double-count controls.
HQ 147 is a separate current scheme and is not substituted for DO37.
HQ 2024/25 lease and practical-completion evidence is not transferred to the DO37 lapsed subrecord.
DO37 point/blank geometry is not converted into a title polygon.
Promotion remains zero until exact current DO37 decision/title relation and overlays are verified.
